I'm going to quit my job at the bank in January and go full-time on the app I've been building on weekends. I've saved 9 months of runway.
I'm doing it. I'm done asking permission from people who've never built anything.

The phone should leave her room at 10pm. I'm the one who has to deal with her in the morning.

raising tenants rent 15%

We have decided to raise our two children vegan. Our paediatrician is supportive as long as we supplement B12. My parents are horrified and keep sneaking them ham.
It's our decision as parents and I'm sticking to it. The ham thing has to stop.

Ok so this is going to be long, sorry. My mom is 81 and lives alone in the house in Kaunas where I grew up. My brother lives 20 minutes from her and I live in Amsterdam, two flights away. Last winter she fell in the kitchen and lay there for maybe two hours before the neighbour heard her. She's fine now, physically, but since then my brother calls me every week with something new, she left the stove on, she forgot her pills, she got scammed on the phone for 300 euros. He has two kids and a job and honestly he's exhausted and I feel guilty because I'm the one who left. Anyway I think she needs to move into the assisted living place near my brother, the one with the garden, and I'm going to tell her that when I fly in next month, even if she cries, because I can't keep waiting for the next fall. My brother thinks we should hire someone to come in every day instead, which is cheaper actually, but she'd hate a stranger in her house and she'd fire them within a week, I know her. And my wife says I'm making this decision from far away because it's easier for me than being there. Maybe. I don't know. She also says mom has a right to take risks with her own life. The house has all of dad's stuff in it still. She talks to his photo. Sorry, I don't even know what I'm asking here.
She needs to move to the assisted living place. I'm telling her next month.

I found out our main supplier in Bangladesh is using subcontractors with no fire exits. I'm going to take it to the board next week and if they do nothing I'll go to a journalist. I know it could cost me my job and the company maybe 200 jobs here.
The board first, and if they stall, the press. People could die in those buildings.
